Name: Kinsward Knight
Information:
**Kinsward Knight**

The kinsward knight is an artificial knight born to protect a specific individual or bloodline. It is magically linked to them, able to receive and carry out orders from anywhere. They do not possess any will except to protect their assigned charge.

***Construct Traits.*** The construct does not require air, nourishment, or water.

Stat Blocks.title: Kinsward Knight
languages: understands commands given in any language but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Charge Guard
traits.description: The construct has advantage on attacks made against any creature in a space adjacent to their charge, or who attacked their charge since the start of the construct’s last turn.

traits.name: Guardian to One
traits.description:
The construct is created to protect a specific target, a token fragment of which (a drop of blood, strand of hair, etc) is included in the process of its creation. It is aware of its charge, their location and their status at all times as long as they are on the same plane. They follow their orders and are willing to sacrifice themselves to protect their charge.

The construct’s charge can use an action to send a command out to any kinsward knights on the same plane as it who are connected to it, telepathically describing a course of action. The constructs will attempt to follow this course of action, acting with the levels of civility expected of their charge when relevant, and may send mental pings to the charge telepathically describing obstacles and situations they encounter that they require instruction to resolve.

traits.name: Valorous Retribution
traits.description: If a creature reduces the knight’s charge to 0 hit points or kills them outright, the construct becomes focused on killing them alone. Until their charge is restored to 1 hit point or more, the construct has advantage on all attack rolls against that target (or group of targets), disadvantage on attacks against other creatures, and can use its bonus action to make one Redemptive Sword attack against those targets on its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The construct makes two Redemptive Sword attacks.

actions.name: Redemptive Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If this attack has advantage due to the construct’s Charge Guard or Valorous Retribution trait, this attack deals an extra d8 of force damage.

reactions.name: Devoted Shield
reactions.description: When a creature hits the construct’s charge while within the construct’s movement range, the construct can use its reaction to move into a space adjacent to the attacker or target, and the construct takes the damage in its place. If this damage reduces the construct to 0 hit points, the damage exceeding its remaining hit points carries over to its original target. If it does, another kinsward knight may use this reaction to similarly take that remaining damage.
